title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — September 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.8 (Peaked September 21, 2026 at 11:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 324 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Pretty quiet out there. ☀️

Today’s imagery shows prominent coronal-hole structure and several bright active-region features, while the coronagraph view appears routine.

Image: Daily Sunwatch — Signal Interruption
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
